summary: Missoula lookout built on Mount Sentinel in 1915 by the University of Montana and burned in 1928 or 1929; no source describes the site today.

notes_for_editor: The fire year conflicts: the Missoulian (November 1928) says the building was destroyed; firelookout.com says it burned in 1929 from a mysterious fire. The 1928 article also says the Forest Service built the lookout in 1914 and that it was used only one season, which conflicts with the 1915 and 1916 papers and with the 1915 build date used in the story. The August 1915 paper says the lookout was built 'last spring', which is ambiguous on the year. The Forest Fire Lookout Association listing says only 'Gone' and gives no fire year; the story no longer attributes the 1929 date to it. Two pages failed to fetch and are not used: a Helena Independent Record article (HTTP 429) and a Forest Fire Lookout Association Facebook post (no text returned); both appear to describe a Forest Service partnership on the lookout, which should be checked before any such claim is added. The concrete M (1968) is not linked to the lookout by any source read. No access or visit facts are recorded. The Montana History Portal photo has no image URL captured, so no photo entry.
